races.verdict: ROCKY'S HOWYA has been prolific in claiming hurdles this season and Declan Queally's veteran can add another to his collection at the expense of Oh So Charming , who ended a long losing run returned to a claimer at Sligo earlier in the month. Howdoyalikeherhome was fourth in that race, and he can edge out Eastern Wind for third. ROCKY'S HOWYA (IRE) OH SO CHARMING HOWDOYALIKEHERHOME (IRE)

races.verdict: MYLUCKYMAKER was value for finishing further clear of the third on her recent yard debut having lost at least 1½ lengths when stumbling over 2f out, so she's worth another chance to open her account. Blue Trix is of obvious interest on debut for a top stable, while Ifuknowuknow contested a notably warm race at Leopardstown when last seen and shouldn't be taken lightly with his slightly longer trip in his favour. Thranduil is another debutant to note. MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE) BLUE TRIX (IRE) IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE)
